# Godot 4.7.2 GDExtension API

`extension_api-4.7.2.json` is generated by the exact patched Godot 4.7.2-stable editor used by the Terrain3D Forward+ ABI 10 integration:

```text
godot.windows.editor.dev.x86_64.console.exe --headless --dump-extension-api
```

`SConstruct` selects this file explicitly. The retained 4.7.1 dump is historical only and is not used by active builds.
